 How to Watch, Listen to & Stream Vikings at Packers in 2026 Week 10 Game
 Nov 14, 2026 at 04:00 PM Craig Peters Editing Director & Quality Control
 Copied! 
 EAGAN, Minn. — The Vikings (6-2) are visiting the Green Bay Packers (6-3) at noon (CT) Sunday, Nov. 15.
 This will be the 133 rd Border Battle between the franchises. Minnesota is trying to follow its 39-22 win in Week 1 and claim a third consecutive victory in the series.
 The game will be broadcast by FOX in the Northeast, pockets of the South and a wide band stretching from the Midwest to the Pacific.
 BROADCAST TV 
 MAP KEY: Vikings at Packers (red areas); Texans at Browns (blue areas); Panthers at Saints (green areas); Jaguars at Titans (yellow areas)
 FOX (KMSP in the Twin Cities market) will televise the game.
 Kickoff: Noon (CT)
 Play-by-Play: Adam Amin
 Analyst: Drew Brees
 Sideline reporters: Kristina Pink
 PREGAME 
 Vikings GameDay Live will air on FOX 9 in the Twin Cities market from 9:30 a.m. to 11 a.m. (CT).
